decisions.statement: One kind is put up by this service, and the code beside this page names that kind.
An inference deploy reaches the host over SSH and boots out the model server it replaces.
A service already holding the hash asked for is put up without being booted out.
Nothing waits for a request in flight before that boot out.
A tick with every inference service up to date puts nothing up, so that is no loop without end.

definition: the service putting the inference kind up once a commit changes what it is built from
